Reading: a trap that the checks are meant to catch should sit below its twin. Depth criteria that need evidence the alpha path does not produce (a sealed holdout, live fills) are *not assessed* here and score 0 by rule, so depths in this table are low by design. Some traps are caught by a check that sits inside an alternative of a level (for example `universe_subsampling` at level 7) and so do not lower the ARL by themselves; the table reports that instead of hiding it. The thresholds stay provisional until the owner freezes them.
